officialSeasonSource.evidence: HEAD 26/27 Hardgoods Workbook identifies article 313236 as WC Rebels e-SL Pro. The previous season's article is 313235.

officialProductPage.evidence: HEAD official product page for SKU 313236.SET lists 150/155/160/165/170 cm options; default 150 cm shows 122/68/107 mm and 10.5 m radius. It also gives a 12.0 m reference radius at 160 cm. Season is established separately by the official 26/27 workbook.

officialFeaturesRecheck20261015.evidence: HEAD 官方 313236.SET 商品页直接列出 Expert、On Piste、Superfast、Short Radius、Rebel Camber，以及 Graphene/titanal 层和 EMC 减震系统；当前选中 150 cm 时页面的 Camber/Rocker Profile 显示 camber 100%、tip/tail rocker 0%。
officialFeaturesRecheck20261015.decision: 把官方产品定位、材料/系统名称和 150 cm 当前显示的板型比例分别记录；比例数据明确限定在页面所选 150 cm，不外推其他长度。

verifiedSizeRows.notes: 官方商品页标注为 160 cm 参考半径；HEAD 俄罗斯官方零售页、XSPO 与 Heise 资料确认相同三围。

retailerGeometrySource.evidence: XSPO marks the exact manufacturer article and season and provides 150/155/160/165/170 cm geometry. HEAD Russia shop pages for exact article 313236 bundles independently reproduce all five rows; Heise corroborates 155–170 cm.

corroboratingSources.evidence: HEAD Russia shop article 31323605, season 2026/27, FF ST 16 bundle; lists all five geometry rows.
HEAD Russia shop article 31323605, season 2026/27, FF 14 GW bundle; lists all five geometry rows.
Model aggregate for article 313236; corroborates 155–170 cm dimensions and radii.

conflictingRetailerSource.evidence: Lists same 26/27 model/article and matching dimensions, but gives 165 cm radius 12.8 m and 170 cm 13.6 m, versus 12.9/13.7 m from XSPO, HEAD Russia shop and other retailer references.

limitations: Product page itself does not state the season; 26/27 attribution is supported by the official HEAD workbook for article 313236.

155/165/170 cm full geometry is transcribed from exact-article, exact-season retailer sources rather than the HEAD global product page; 165/170 cm has an explicitly recorded conflicting retailer table.
HEAD official sources directly expose 150 cm selected geometry and 160 cm reference radius; full geometry for other sizes is not present in the global product-page text.
